records.assessment: Full unique remerge resolution reviewed: migrate signature/size arguments, move descriptor validation out of the wrapper, widen exported helper size from u32 to size_t, and retain the then-existing incfs wrapper. The wrapper/export were subsequently removed by 7f2bfb86500c. Keep native size_t signature API, descriptor bounds checks in open.c and enable.c, and newer empty-keyring rejection and LSM integrity notification. signature.c is byte-identical to pinned LTS; new header additions concern prefetch only. No surviving unique signature behavior requires replay; built-in signatures are disabled in SDK but their native security behavior is retained.

Both unique remerge hunks reviewed: remove valid-signature debug output, and move the then-existing exported helper declaration/stub after new open/setattr wrappers. Current signature.c equals LTS and has no removed debug output. The exported helper declaration/stub were subsequently removed by 7f2bfb86500c; native fsverity_file_open and inode setattr protection remain. Do not resurrect the reverted helper or historical wrapper arrangement. Native signature/descriptor/LSM security checks remain.

Re-reviewed complete removal of the incfs signature-export wrapper after new prefetch/header changes invalidated the old whole-file witness. The signature.c result remains byte-identical to LTS; no __fsverity_verify_signature definition/declaration/export or incfs caller exists in current selected source or final ACK. Keep native validated vi hash algorithm/digest and size_t signature parameters, empty-keyring parser avoidance and LSM integrity notification. New trace/prefetch declarations do not restore this reverted API.

Provide CONFIG_FS_VERITY=n inline no-op fsverity_readahead, adapting the parameter back to the retained native inode API. The source fix addresses dead-code-elimination assumptions; the unconditional configured filesystem call sites must not require an undefined symbol in alternate Android configurations. SDK enables verity, but the optional feature needs a coherent source stub. Extracted disabled-config stub compiles/links at -O0 and has no undefined prefetch symbol. No verification bypass when verity is enabled.
